description: Estimate how much revenue a business loses to unanswered calls, from its own call volume and average job value. No sign-in needed. Ask the user for their numbers rather than guessing them.

avg_job_value.description: Average revenue from one booked job, in dollars.

booking_percent.description: Share of answered calls that become a booked job. Default 50 is an assumption.

calls_per_week.description: Inbound calls the business gets in a typical week.

missed_percent.description: Share of calls that go unanswered. Default 30 is an assumption; use the business's own figure if known.

name: missed_call_cost
title: Missed-call cost calculator
